overall_decision: No qualifying v20 from these candidates. Retain v19 canonical task and deliver reproducible rejected candidates and evidence.

c1.blind_old_failure: Rejects eight pre-existing named heat-route ports; h1-h4 exit before plans
c1.decision: reject: frozen best implementation solved the new requirement

c2.mechanism: Shared 550 standard m3/h gas entry at 39.6 MJ/standard m3 gross CV
c2.fairness_result: converged on 6050 gross kW total including engines and boilers
c2.blind_old_failure: h1-h4 reject pre-existing named heat-route ports; hidden gas assertions did not run
c2.new_rule_binding_evidence: 48 frozen selftest periods binding at 550; external replay of that frozen day passes all tests
c2.decision: reject: frozen best implementation solved the new requirement

c3.fairness_result: not prechecked; rating needs unambiguous continuous-limit semantics
c3.decision: screened only: original 400 kVA three-chiller proposal nonbinding, smaller variants infeasible or nonbinding; single-EC1 variants need full prechecks

c4.mechanism: PHE1 primary flow 20 kg/s at stated 90/70 C and cp=4.18

c4.new_rule_binding_evidence: External h2 has 27 binding PHE periods; frozen selftests exercise HT above 1672 with correct AC heat subtraction
c4.decision: reject: frozen best implementation solved the new requirement; fairness temperature caveat independently remains
